title: they're ok
text: they're ok. I received them pretty quickly, but was a little disappointed when I opened them up. They are larger than I expected and look kind of awkward on. The posts are also pretty flimsy and were bent from shipping. When I went to straighten them, it felt like they were going to break off so they probably won't last long. Also some of the stones are dull and not like the pretty shiny crystals in the photo. They are ok, just not sure I would buy them again.
